teaser: A brief for an iPad app to review the book: PDFs, comments on the page, append lanes, a vault opened with my passkey, and sgit in Swift.
core_idea: The iPad is where I review because it is like a book, but Preview and two separate PDFs make a review hard; an iPad app built to review the book would read the PDFs properly, show comments, cards and votes on the page, exchange JSON tied to the semantic graph through append lanes, keep its library in an sgit vault opened with a passkey's PRF secret, implement sgit natively in Swift as the format's third implementation, and meter use with a balance that can go negative, because the reader pays for use and is not the product; the March desktop app gives the account, signing and pipeline, but this app should be native.

quotes.text: The reader is the customer, not the product.
quotes.why: The idea the meter rests on.

quotes.text: A format with three implementations, in three languages, written by different teams, is far more of a standard than one with two.
once we control the medium the review does not have to be a second PDF
